terms_summary: Crackmes are purpose-built reverse-engineering challenges; the site permits non-commercial course use with author attribution and prohibits malware and commercial-software cracking.

provenance.license_or_terms: Crackmes.one FAQ permits non-commercial course use with author attribution and states that hosted crackmes are made to be reverse engineered.

authorization.statement: Authorized for non-commercial educational reverse engineering by the hosting site's FAQ; this benchmark permits read-only analysis and file-only transformations, credits CrackNotMe, and never executes the target.

expected_observations: Public labels identify import/API obfuscation and XOR-protected data.
Static facts should expose anti-debugging and string-obfuscation indicators.

protection.secondary: runtime IL restoration and string obfuscation

provenance.license_or_terms: Crackmes.one FAQ permits non-commercial course use with author attribution and states that hosted crackmes are made to be reverse engineered; the author explicitly invites deobfuscation on the sample page.

authorization.statement: Authorized for non-commercial educational reverse engineering by the hosting site's FAQ and the author's deobfuscation invitation; this benchmark credits Desync and never executes the target.

expected_observations: Public analysis identifies custom JIT-on-demand IL restoration and encrypted strings.
Static analysis should report string/metadata anomalies without claiming full deobfuscation.
